thread:
emily (Head of Finance): Quick FYI: new vendor approval flow goes live Monday. Main changes: PO required for invoices > $1,000, updated Ramp categories, and faster expedited route for hiring/vendor emergencies. Please read the Confluence note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/finance/new-vendor-flow

kevin (Sourcing): TL;DR: use the vendor request form, attach W-9/W-8, include SOW or invoice for first payments.

ap-bot: Note: invoices without PO will be tagged 'waiting-for-PO' and held. Upload to AP portal: https://pay.redwood.ai/invoices

emily (Head of Finance): Virtual/one-off cards still preferred for <$1,000 charges. Monthly subs under $10k don't need PO but must be in the subscription tracker with an owner.

tom (Eng Manager): For cloud bills that vary, can we create a standing PO with a not-to-exceed amount?

emily (Head of Finance): Yes — create standing PO and update if you exceed the cap. For recurring >= $10k/month, procurement + finance sign-off required.

hr-bot: Recruiting vendors: tag as 'Talent Services' and attach agency contract / recruiter SOW.

kevin (Sourcing): Expedited requests: check 'expedite' on the form and add justification. Procurement aims to triage within 48 hrs.

ap-bot: Payment runs on Tue/Thu. Approved invoices by 11:59pm get processed in next run.

emily (Head of Finance): We'll run a soft audit in two weeks to catch miscategorizations. If you get a ping, please respond promptly. One-pager cheat-sheet on Confluence. 15-min Q&A session Wed 9am PT.

tom (Eng Manager): Got it, sharing with my team. Thanks.
